description: Solar icon set, maintained and extended: 1,576 SVG icons in 6 styles for JS, Flutter, Rails, Blade, Blazor, Figma, CLI & MCP.

latest_release.name: @solar-icons/mcp@2.11.0
latest_release.body:
### Minor Changes

- [#758](https://github.com/saoudi-h/solar-icons/pull/758) [`f937168`](https://github.com/saoudi-h/solar-icons/commit/f9371684c464b40b20786e145b60cb759aebeced) Thanks [@saoudi-h](https://github.com/saoudi-h)! - Expand catalogue to 1,596 icon families (9,576 SVGs):
  
  - Add 20 new `Sports` icon families across all 6 canonical styles (`Bold`, `BoldDuotone`, `Broken`, `Linear`, `LineDuotone`, `Outline`): `sport-shoe`, `footprints`, `kettlebell`, `biceps-flexed`, `jump-rope`, `yoga-mat`, `baseball`, `ping-pong`, `hockey`, `cricket`, `tennis-racket`, `skiing`, `boxing-glove`, `kayak`, `bow-arrow`, `fishing-rod`, `swimming-pool`, `whistle`, `sport-field`, and `flag-checkered`.
  
  - Fix open stroke endpoints to use round caps in 9 `tools` icons: `opacity` (Broken, Linear), `contrast` (Linear, LineDuotone), `flat-brush` (Linear, LineDuotone), `exclude` (Linear) and `subtract-minimalistic` (Linear, LineDuotone).

### Patch Changes

- Updated dependencies [[`f937168`](https://github.com/saoudi-h/solar-icons/commit/f9371684c464b40b20786e145b60cb759aebeced)]:
  - @solar-icons/cli@2.13.0

detail.readme: [![Solar Icons](apps/docs-start/ressources/solar-icons-banner.png 'Solar Icons')](https://solar-icons.dev) # Solar Icons Solar Icons is a single icon catalogue for product interfaces, documentation, and developer tools: 1,596 icons across six styles (9,576 SVG variations), with the same collection distributed across frameworks, Figma, SVG assets, the CLI, and MCP. [Browse the catalogue](https://solar-icons.dev) · [Read the documentation](https://solar-icons.dev/docs/v2) · [Open the Figma library](https://www.figma.com/community/file/1700288903247372375/solar-icons-dev-icon-library) · [Install the Figma plugin](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1664759238792120976) ## Why Solar Icons - Six styles for the same icon set: `Linear`, `Broken`, `Outline`, `Bold`, `LineDuotone`, and `BoldDuotone`. - Framework packages with typed components and tree-shakeable imports. - Shared controls for size, color, stroke width, and duotone colors. - Framework-free SVG, sprite, ESM, and vanilla JavaScript options. - The same catalogue is available in Figma and through developer tooling. ```sh npm install @solar-icons/react ``` ```tsx import { HomeIcon } from '@solar-icons/react/linear' export function Example() { return } ``` Each style has its own import path. See the [React guide](https://solar-icons.dev/docs/v2/packages/react) for providers, CSS variables, and duotone settings. For other frameworks, choose the matching package above or browse the [package documentation](https://solar-icons.dev/docs/v2/packages). ## Tools - **Figma library:** Editable components with all six styles side by side and local variables for colour, stroke width and duotone opacity. [Open the Community file](https://www.figma.com/community/file/1700288903247372375/solar-icons-dev-icon-library). - **Figma plugin:** Browse the catalogue and insert the same SVG assets used by the packages. [Install it from Figma](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1664759238792120976). - **CLI:** Search, inspect, list, and export icons locally. See [`@solar-icons/cli`](packages/cli/README.md). - **MCP:** Expose icon search and retrieval to MCP-compatible clients. See [`@solar-icons/mcp`](packages/mcp/README.md). - **Agent Skill:** Give an agent a searchable Solar Icons catalogue with [`skills/solar-icons/SKILL.md`](skills/solar-icons/SKILL.md). ```sh npx skills add saoudi-h/solar-icons --skill solar-icons npx @solar-icons/cli search "home" --limit 10 --json ``` The documentation site also provides [`/llms.txt`](https://solar-icons.dev/llms.txt) and [`/llms-full.txt`](https://solar-icons.dev/llms-full.txt) for tools that work better with plain-text documentation. ## Migration from v1 Run the [codemod](https://solar-icons.dev/docs/v2/migration-to-v2/codemod) to migrate supported imports and component names. It previews changes before writing files and reports cases that need manual review. ## Requests and contributions Missing an icon? [Request one](https://github.com/saoudi-h/solar-icons/issues/new?template=icon-request.yml) and explain where you would use it. No drawing or code is required. Code, documentation and icon contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, review and licensing. Agree on an icon's scope in an issue before drawing it; review starts with Linear. ## Other projects Related open-source projects by [Hakim Saoudi](https://github.com/saoudi-h): - [Postdot](https://postdot.app/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=solar-icons): self-hosted social publishing for you and your agents - [RateLock](https://ratelock-docs.vercel.app/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=solar-icons): rate limiting for Node.js, Bun and other runtimes - [tw-screens](https://github.com/saoudi-h/tw-screens): responsive breakpoint hooks inspired by Tailwind CSS - [Autonomos](https://github.com/saoudi-h/autonomos): a protocol that gives AI coding agents structured project context - [Tala Tools](https://github.com/saoudi-h/tala-tools): shared lint, format, TypeScript and build configurations ## License - **Code:** MIT - **Original icons and corrections:** [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) by [480 Design](https://www.figma.com/community/file/1166831539721848736). Attribution is required. - **New original icons:** MIT, with authors credited in the catalogue. ## Credits - **480 Design:** Original Solar icon set. - **Noaman Monther ([devnoaman](https://github.com/devnoaman)):** Flutter package (`flutter_solar_icons`). - **Taha Reeh ([TahaReeh](https://github.com/TahaReeh)):** Blazor package (`SolarIcons.Blazor`). - **Phosphor Icons** and **Lucide Icons:** Inspiration for the package structure.
